title: Bonds, Carnival Fun & River Damages in Austin
summary:
*   **Voters to Consider Major Public Works Bonds**: An election was ordered for property taxpayers to approve funding for significant infrastructure projects, including street improvements, bridges, storm/sanitary sewers, public schools, and a city-wide fire/police alarm system.
*   **Wortham Shows Carnival Gets Green Light**: A multi-day carnival was granted a permit, allowing temporary street closures and use of a city park, with strict warnings against damaging public roads.
*   **Dam Compensation Approved**: Funds were appropriated to compensate a property owner for land submerged and damages incurred due to the city's dam project on the Colorado River.
*   **Citizen Advisory Board for Streets Formed**: A new committee of citizens was appointed to serve as an advisory board for permanent street paving and improvement projects.

April 26th 1915. All present:
Councilman Bartholomew offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin,Texas: That the sum of one thousand ($1,000.00) dollars be and the same
is he hereby appropriated out of the Earnings fund of the Water, Light and Power Dept of
the City of Austin ,Texas, for the year 1915, and made payable to Mrs Anita C Quinlin and
Husband , Jas W Quinlin,for the value of submerged landsand other damages done their
propertyby reason of the lake formed by the dam building by the City of Austin across the
Colorado River.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony ,Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.

April 27th 1915: All present:
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin,Texas: That a cordial invitation be and is hereby extendedto the
Modern Order of Pretorians to hold its next biennial Convention in the City of
Austin,Texas.
We urge the Pretorians to accept this invitation ,and should they becom our guests at
their next biennial State Senate ,the utmost hospitality of the
City will be placed at their disposal.

Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5
